https://mastodon.social/@kimcrawley@stop.text: Heads up, everyone. I really enjoy playing Megabonk every so often. You know, that PC game that's been very commercially successful on Steam, and is clearly inspired by Vampire Survivors and Risk of Rain 2. The real life identity of Megabonk's developer isn't officially confirmed, but there's no reason to believe that it's anything but a game lovingly crafted with custom assets and some middleware. It's made like a good quality indie game prior to 2022. 1/x #gaming #Steam 1/2
